title: Pi web-search config
description: Configuration for pi-web-access plugin (fetch_content, web_search tools)

trustEnvProxy.description: When true and an HTTP proxy is configured via env vars, skip the DNS preflight SSRF check and let the proxy handle resolution. Required inside SRT sandbox where direct DNS is blocked.

allowRanges.description: CIDR ranges exempted from the SSRF guard (e.g. fake-IP proxy ranges)
